shots.say: How does Hazel find snacks at night? Look! It is very dark. But Hazel's nose goes sniff, sniff!
shots.tag: hook: Hazel sniffs in the moonlit wood

shots.say: The Animated Zoo!
Hello, I'm Milo! The moon is coming up. And I am visiting Hazel the hedgehog.
shots.tag: dusk: Milo and Hazel by her nest

shots.say: Good evening, Milo! I just woke up. And I am hungry! Time for my night-time snack hunt!
shots.tag: Hazel: time for my snack hunt

shots.say: But Milo is sleepy. Birds like me sleep at night! Can I come too, Hazel?
shots.tag: Milo: sleepy, can I come too

shots.say: Yes! Come and see what a hedgehog does at night!
When does Hazel look for her snacks? In the day, or at night?
Hedgehogs sleep in the day. At night, they wake up, and look for food.
shots.tag: fact: hedgehogs sleep in the day, hunt at night

shots.say: When do hedgehogs look for food? At night, or in the day?
Off they go, deep into the wood, under the tall, tall trees.
shots.tag: the dark wood under tall trees

shots.say: Where are the snacks? I can not see a thing! It is too dark for my eyes.
shots.tag: Milo: I can not see a thing

shots.say: Can you look around, like Milo? Look this way. Look that way!
Can Milo see any snacks in the dark? Yes, or no?
That's okay, Milo! I do not need my eyes. I have my nose! Sniff, sniff!
Hedgehogs can not see very well. They use their nose, and their ears, to find food.
shots.tag: fact: hedgehogs use their nose to find food

shots.say: What helps Hazel find her food? Her nose, or her tail?
Hazel's nose leads the way, to a path full of leaves. And Hazel smells a beetle!
Milo hops closer. But the dry leaves go crunch! Crunch, crunch!
The beetle hears the noise. And it scuttles away, under the leaves.
Can you tiptoe, like Milo? Tip, tip, tiptoe!
Are the dry leaves quiet, or crunchy?
Never mind the beetle. My nose can smell something even better!
Hedgehogs eat beetles, caterpillars, and worms. Those are hedgehog snacks!
shots.tag: fact: hedgehogs eat beetles, caterpillars and worms

shots.say: Count the hedgehog snacks with Milo! One, two, three!
What do hedgehogs eat? Beetles, or pizza?
Sniff, sniff! Hazel follows the smell, to a clearing. The best smell of all comes from under a big log.
It smells so yummy! But it is under the log.
shots.tag: Hazel: it smells yummy, under the log

shots.say: I will lift it! Push, push, push! But the log is much too big, and much too heavy.
shots.tag: Milo tries to lift the log

shots.say: Can you push, like Milo? Push, push, push!
Then Milo peeks under the log. But it is too dark under there.
shots.tag: Milo peeks under the log: too dark

shots.say: Can Milo lift the big log? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: can Milo lift the log

shots.say: Milo sits down next to Hazel. The moon shines. The log is still there.
shots.tag: they sit together by the log

shots.say: The log is too big, and it is too dark. Maybe we can not get the snack.
shots.tag: Milo: maybe we can not get the snack

shots.say: How do Milo and Hazel feel now? Sad, or happy?
Wait! I do not need to lift it. I do not need to see. I can follow my nose, and snuffle under!
shots.tag: Hazel's idea: follow my nose, snuffle under

shots.say: So Hazel puts her little nose down, and snuffles in, under the log. Snuffle, snuffle! Grunt, grunt!
Out comes Hazel, with a big bunch of juicy blackberries! Enough for two!
Who found the snack? Hazel, or Milo?
Hazel, you did it! You found the snack with your nose!
Can you sniff, like Hazel? Sniff, sniff, sniff!
Sniff and snuffle, through the night. My little nose can find a bite!
Munch, munch, yum! Then, the sky turns pink. The sun is coming up!
Now it is my bedtime. Hedgehogs sleep in the day! Good night, Milo.
shots.tag: Hazel: now it is my bedtime

shots.say: Hazel curls up, in her cosy leaf nest. And Milo is wide awake!
shots.tag: Hazel in her leaf nest, Milo awake

shots.say: Some friends sleep in the day, and look for food at night. Thank you, Hazel!
shots.tag: Milo: some friends sleep in the day

shots.say: Do you remember? When do hedgehogs look for food? At night, or in the day?
And what helps Hazel find her food? Her eyes, or her nose?
Sniff and snuffle, through the night. My little nose can find a bite!
Next time: Hazel and the Crunchy Leaf Bed! See you on the next adventure, friends!
Thank you, friends! If you like The Animated Zoo, don't forget to like and subscribe, to keep supporting our zoo friends. See you next time!
The Animated Zoo!
